worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.summary: Hurl a dark mirror shard; whoever it strikes has every stat change on them turned upside down — raised levels become lowered and lowered become raised. The higher a foe has built itself up, the harder it falls; if it is already dragging debuffs, the flip helps it instead, so read its ladder first.
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.use.0: Turn a foe's stacked buffs into an equal pile of debuffs
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.use.1: Yank away the advantage right after a foe maxes its offense
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.use.2: Harass a bulky target that keeps buffing itself
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.description: The shard reaches %1$s blocks, breaks into %2$s pieces and flies at %3$s blocks/tick; everyone it strikes has every non-zero stat change inverted.
It resolves at a radius of %1$s blocks; a flipped target keeps the inverted mark for about %2$s (recording how many entries turned), and a miss bursts into cold light across about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.option.on: Selective: only raised entries on the target are flipped, debuffs are left alone — it never accidentally helps a foe; the cost is wind-up +4 ticks, cooldown +20 ticks and reach -1 block.
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.option.off: Total: raised and lowered both flip — longer, faster and cheaper; the cost is that a foe already carrying debuffs gets a boost from the flip.
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.timing: Reach %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s from commit. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.topsyturvy.growth.0: From level %1$s: the shard reaches %2$s blocks and the cooldown drops to %3$s.
On (Selective): only raised entries are flipped, debuffs are left alone so a foe is never helped; the cost is wind-up +4 ticks, cooldown +20 ticks and reach -1 block. Off (Total): raised and lowered both flip — longer, faster and cheaper, but a foe full of debuffs gains from it.
The partner only considers the mirror while a threat is this close; larger throws it earlier and risks more misses.
Once the target's total raised levels reach this, the partner ranks Topsy-Turvy above ordinary fighting; 1 flips on any gain, larger waits until a foe has built up.
world_combat.move.topsyturvy.text.empty: The mirror slides by (nothing to invert)
